        13       President.

        14                      I think everyone knows really

        15       what the problem is, and I think most of us

        16       believe, however well, that fingerprinting

        17       should be a part of the solution.  It will save

        18       us an awful lot of money and restore credibility

        19       to the system.  With fingerprinting we have, of

        20       course, an opportunity to return credibility,

        21       responsibility and integrity to a system which

        22       is widely perceived by the public as being a red

        23       tape bureaucracy which is absolutely riddled











                                                             
2219

         1       with fraud.

         2                      The problem is -- some of the

         3       problems, welfare is growing at 12, 15, 20, 30

         4       percent a year.  In this year's budget, Medicaid

         5       and welfare is approximately $24 billion of the

         6       $63 billion total budget, or 38 percent of the

         7       budget, and the people are telling us and, in

         8       fact, begging us to clean up the system.  The

         9       people are hating and mistrusting anyone on

        10       welfare, mistrusting anyone who needs help, not

        11       because they need help because I think most of

        12       us want to help them, but because of the limited

        13       number of thieves who are stealing from the

        14       system.

        15                      You've all heard the testimony,

        16       testimony before my committee, testimony before

        17       other committees, from all over the state and

        18       all over the nation that fraud and abuse in the

        19       Medicaid and welfare system is five percent of

        20       that $24 billion, is ten percent of that $24

        21       billion, and it's even been suggested it's 25

        22       percent of that $24 billion, but realistically

        23       if it's five percent, then we are being ripped











                                                             
2220

         1       off, the taxpayers of this state and we're

         2       allowing it, if it's five percent, $1.2 billion

         3       dollars.  It's more likely that it's near 10

         4       percent and that means we're allowing the

         5       taxpayers of this state to be ripped off for

         6       approximately $2.4 billion a year.

         7                      Now, some people say that the

         8       system is degrading.  I certainly don't think

         9       so, but we need to improve the system.  We need

        10       to tighten up the management.  We need to offer

        11       better management tools to clean up the system

        12       and every time we do it there's another reason

        13       why we shouldn't be able to do that.  In the

        14       meantime, as we said, the taxpayers are being

        15       ripped off for $2 billion a year and we can not

        16       agree on a solution.
